pages.title: Waddle Dee Sleeping Beneath Whispy Woods Coloring Page
pages.description: Waddle Dee sleeps beneath Whispy Woods in this printable coloring page, sitting with closed eyes against the tree's large trunk and exposed roots among scattered grass tufts. Whispy Woods' face appears above the sleeping character. The broad canopy and trunk leave spacious coloring areas with a few leaf and bark details.

pages.title: Waddle Dee Working as a Lumberjack Beside a Stack of Logs Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Waddle Dee working as a lumberjack beside stacked logs, gripping an axe while wearing a checked shirt and matching pompom hat. A large tree stump fills the foreground, with growth rings and bark lines. Clothing squares and log ends provide repeated patterns across the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Waddle Dee Guarding the Entrance to King Dedede's Castle Coloring Page
pages.description: Waddle Dee guards the entrance to King Dedede's castle in this printable coloring page, holding an upright spear before a double door topped by a large star emblem. Matching banners hang from the round towers. The coloring sheet combines broad character shapes with narrow spear details, stonework, and tiled paving.

pages.title: Parasol Waddle Dee Floating Down Beneath an Open Umbrella Coloring Page
pages.description: Parasol Waddle Dee floats down beneath an open umbrella in this printable coloring page, gripping its curved handle above a grassy hill and small rounded bushes. Wide canopy panels and tiny circular tips define the umbrella. The coloring sheet keeps the background open, with a few clouds around the airborne character.

pages.title: Yarn Waddle Dee Floating with a Balloon in Patch Land Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Yarn Waddle Dee floating with a balloon in Patch Land, holding its string beside stitched clouds above rolling patchwork hills. Dashed seams trace the balloon, face panel, arms, and feet. Button-like circles and fabric divisions add small details among the large rounded shapes on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Bandana Waddle Dee Standing Ready with His Spear Coloring Page
pages.description: Bandana Waddle Dee stands ready with his spear in this printable coloring page, holding the long shaft beside his rounded face and tied headband with trailing ends. A small ribbon sits below the pointed spearhead. The plain background highlights broad body areas, the narrow shaft, and simple fabric folds.

pages.title: Bandana Waddle Dee Hovering Over a Gap with Waddle Copter Coloring Page
pages.description: Bandana Waddle Dee hovers over a gap with Waddle Copter in this printable coloring page, raising his spear overhead beneath broad circular spinning lines and a trailing ribbon. Grass-topped cliffs frame the opening below him. Large character shapes contrast with the narrow spear, motion arcs, and small plants along the ledges.

pages.title: Bandana Waddle Dee Throwing a Spear at a Flying Bronto Burt Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Bandana Waddle Dee throwing a spear at a flying Bronto Burt, extending one arm as the spear travels upward toward the winged enemy. Rounded hills and grass mark the ground. The coloring sheet pairs large character outlines with small wing spots, headband folds, and motion lines.

pages.title: Bandana Waddle Dee Riding on Car Mouth Kirby Coloring Page
pages.description: Bandana Waddle Dee rides on Car Mouth Kirby in this printable coloring page, sitting above the rounded car body as a curved road runs past low bushes and a guardrail. Kirby's face fills the front above the bumper. Broad body panels and wheels leave spacious sections around the smaller road markings.

pages.title: Bandana Waddle Dee Breaking Stone Blocks in Megaton Punch Coloring Page
pages.description: Bandana Waddle Dee breaks stone blocks in Megaton Punch in this printable coloring page, driving one fist into a cracked wall as fragments scatter above the platform. Ruined arches and a small star-topped structure appear behind him. Angular rubble and floor cracks add details around his broad body and tied headband.

pages.title: Bandana Waddle Dee Using His Parasol to Gather Apples with Kirby in Apple Scramble Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Bandana Waddle Dee gathering apples with Kirby in Apple Scramble, holding an open parasol beneath falling fruit and a leafy tree. Kirby jumps beside a woven basket already filled with apples. Umbrella panels, individual leaves, and small grass tufts create varied coloring areas throughout the scene.

pages.title: Bandana Waddle Dee Following Kirby Along a Rainbow Rope Drawn By Elline Coloring Page
pages.description: Bandana Waddle Dee follows Kirby along a rainbow rope drawn by Elline in this printable coloring page, crossing a gap while Elline paints the curved path overhead. Waddle Dee carries his spear behind Kirby. Parallel rainbow bands, scattered stars, and cliff faces create clear sections around the three characters.

pages.title: Bandana Waddle Dee Arriving as a Dream Friend at the Dream Palace Coloring Page
pages.description: Bandana Waddle Dee arrives as a Dream Friend at the Dream Palace in this printable coloring page, lifting his spear above a circular platform beside a large floating heart. Stars decorate the palace arches, columns, and platform edge. Broad character areas contrast with the narrow spear, ribbon, and layered architectural borders.

pages.title: Bandana Waddle Dee Fishing Beside Kirby at the Waddle Dee Town Pond Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Bandana Waddle Dee fishing beside Kirby at the Waddle Dee Town pond, with two rods and round floats resting among water ripples. Rounded houses, a fence, and a star banner stand behind the grassy bank. Thin fishing lines and small windows add details to the open scene.

pages.title: Wise Waddle Dee Sharing Advice with Kirby Beside His Book Coloring Page
pages.description: Wise Waddle Dee shares advice with Kirby beside his book in this printable coloring page, wearing round glasses and a mortarboard with a hanging tassel. The large open book fills the foreground beneath the seated characters. Broad blank pages contrast with the narrower glasses rims, page edges, and cap details.

pages.title: Item-shop Waddle Dee Presenting a Power-up Bottle to Kirby Coloring Page
pages.description: Item-shop Waddle Dee presents a power-up bottle to Kirby in this printable coloring page, standing behind a counter beneath a paneled awning and wearing a star-badged cap. Kirby reaches for the rounded bottle marked with another star. Large counter panels and character shapes surround the smaller cap, bottle, and hand details.

pages.title: Cafe-staff Waddle Dee Serving Food at the Waddle Dee Cafe Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Cafe-staff Waddle Dee serving food at the Waddle Dee Cafe, carrying a sandwich and a lidded drink on a round tray. A soft cap and tied apron distinguish the uniform. Hanging lamps, a plant, and a food display provide background details around the large central figure.

pages.title: Delivery Waddle Dee Handing Kirby a Parcel at Waddle Dee-liveries Coloring Page
pages.description: Delivery Waddle Dee hands Kirby a parcel at Waddle Dee-liveries in this printable coloring page, passing the boxed package across a service counter beneath a broad awning. Waddle Dee wears a peaked cap with a circular badge. The parcel bands and vertical counter boards add smaller straight-edged sections beside the rounded characters.

pages.title: Waddle Dee Opening a Capsule Beside the Town's Gotcha Machine Coloring Page
pages.description: Waddle Dee opens a capsule beside the town's Gotcha Machine in this printable coloring page, holding the two round halves in front of the machine's capsule-filled globe. A large star crowns the dispenser above its turning handle. Houses, railings, and paving add smaller background shapes to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Waddle Dees Cheering for Bandana Waddle Dee at the Colosseum Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Waddle Dees cheering for Bandana Waddle Dee at the Colosseum, raising their arms from two tiers of seats as he lifts his spear. Star banners hang between the arched openings, and flags rise above the walls. Repeated stonework surrounds the broad foreground figure and decorated spear.

pages.title: Kirby Waddle Dee in Royal Throne Room Coloring Page
pages.description: Kirby and Waddle Dee appear in a royal throne room in this printable coloring page, with Kirby seated on an ornate throne while Waddle Dee holds a spear nearby. Patterned columns, hanging banners, and an arched window surround them. Crown motifs and curled chair details create smaller sections across the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Kirby Waddle Dee in Sky Castle Coloring Page
pages.description: Kirby and Waddle Dee visit a sky castle in this printable coloring page, following cloud paths toward three flagged towers beneath a crescent moon and scattered stars. Waddle Dee carries a spear beside Kirby. The coloring sheet combines large cloud shapes with narrow ribbons, castle windows, and small star decorations.

pages.title: Kirby Waddle Dee in Star Portal Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Kirby and Waddle Dee at a star portal, with Kirby raising a star wand while Waddle Dee sits on a smaller star nearby. Swirls, sparkles, and radiating lines decorate the large portal. A winding path and bushes below add landscape shapes beneath the ornate star border.

pages.title: Kirby Waddle Dee in Cloud Kingdom Coloring Page
pages.description: Kirby and Waddle Dee appear in a cloud kingdom in this printable coloring page, with Kirby outlined as a star beside Waddle Dee's upright spear. A rainbow, a star-marked block, and a simple sun fill the sky. Layered cloud platforms create broad rounded coloring sections around the small costume and spear details.

pages.title: Kirby Waddle Dee in Dream Land Meadow Coloring Page
pages.description: Kirby and Waddle Dee stand in a Dream Land meadow in this printable coloring page, surrounded by flowers and grass beneath spiral-decorated clouds and gently rolling hills. Small trees and distant mountains complete the background. The coloring sheet offers open character areas with finer petals, leaves, and scattered stones below.

pages.title: Kirby Waddle Dee in Dream Land Village Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page places Kirby and Waddle Dee in Dream Land Village, beside small rounded houses and a path leading toward a star-shaped building on a hill. Waddle Dee carries a spear while Kirby steps forward. Roof lines, round windows, and scattered stones add detail to the open village scene.

pages.title: Kirby Waddle Dee in Castle Courtyard Coloring Page
pages.description: Kirby and Waddle Dee visit a castle courtyard in this printable coloring page, standing on a cobbled path while Waddle Dee holds a small triangular flag. An arched gate with a raised portcullis stands between towers behind them. A bench, bare tree, and bushes provide additional shapes around the two characters.

pages.title: Kirby Waddle Dee in Candy Kingdom Coloring Page
pages.description: Kirby and Waddle Dee explore a candy kingdom in this printable coloring page, walking past spiral lollipops, candy canes, gumdrop shapes, and an icing-roofed house toward a distant castle. Wrapped sweets and stars line the foreground path. The coloring sheet combines broad character areas with many small decorative food patterns.

pages.title: Kirby Waddle Dee in King Dedede's Castle Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Kirby and Waddle Dee at King Dedede's castle, with Waddle Dee holding a spear beneath a hanging star banner beside tall stone columns. An arched opening and small window frame the pair. Repeated floor tiles and scattered wall bricks add geometric sections around the rounded figures.

pages.title: Kirby Waddle Dee in Seaside Village Coloring Page
pages.description: Kirby and Waddle Dee visit a seaside village in this printable coloring page, standing beside a small boat, a starfish, and a path leading toward a wooden house. A palm tree and low shoreline mark the coast. Large sky and sand areas contrast with the smaller boat, roof, and headband details.

pages.title: Kirby Waddle Dee in Waddle Dee Town Coloring Page
pages.description: Kirby and Waddle Dee appear in Waddle Dee Town in this printable coloring page, standing on cobbled streets between rounded houses, a bench, and a tall streetlamp. A sign reading Waddle Dee hangs above one doorway. Window panes, roof seams, and leafy trees add smaller details around the broad character outlines.
